notes: The *it* of *it is blessed* resumes בֵּית in a later verbless clause with no subject of its own and joins that noun's discontinuous unit, headed on *house* (rule 25); the *it* of *it may continue* is the infinitive's supplied subject (rule 52). Impersonal *it hath pleased thee* stays whole on הוֹאַלְתָּ (rule 44).
